newsitem.title: INDIA: Speculative buying drives India castor up.
newsitem.headline: Speculative buying drives India castor up.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery jumped up to 1,160/1,161 rupees per quintal from 1,151/1,152 rupees on the back of hectic speculative buying, dealers said.
Continued buying by shippers and limited supplies prompted buoyancy while bears were busy covering short positions.
"Local shippers are short and covering by them kept spot prices firm," one operator said.
"Firm tendency in the spot prices also aided the upsurge in the forward market," he added.
"Meanwhile forward market commission has granted permission for December delivery and trading in the December delivery will commence in a day or two," he said.
Groundnut oil slid by 2/3 rupees at 370/372 rupees per 10 kg amid lower than expected seasonal buying while losses in producing centres prompted profit-taking.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil slid by 5 rupees at 590/595 rupees per 15 kg.
Meanwhile in Bombay imported palm-oil rose by two rupees at 253/254 rupees per 10 kg on the back of a recovery in the world market.
"Limited offerings by local importers at lower levels also helped palm-oil prices to bounce back after recent losses," said Praful Mody, a leading dealer.
